name: WalkingPad Control
author: Sascha Hillig (shllg)
description: BLE control and status for a KingSmith WalkingPad with no vendor app, account, or network access.

barWidget.description: Bar icon for a KingSmith WalkingPad, with a panel to start, stop and set the speed.

schema.label: Session gap (minutes)
schema.description: Two bouts of walking closer together than this are treated as one session in the analysis window.
